text: I feel a sense of curiosity awakening in me as I gaze at this R+D exhibition. The modern, brightly lit environment — marked by glass walls, vibrant colors, and neatly arranged displays — exudes an atmosphere of innovative energy. Here, my thoughts spiral around the restless evolution of knowledge and technology. The images and text invite me to ponder how we, as humans, respond and adapt to the rapid transformation of our world. In this space, I am both observer and participant in the play of discovery.
